market_secondaryScreensChartFullInterval.en: Intervals: 15m / 1h / 4h / 1D / 1W. Drag sideways for earlier data, pinch to zoom, long-press to see a candle's price and time. MA and VOL are calculated on device from the chart's closes and volume, with no separate data source. There are no other indicators and no drawing tools.
market_secondaryScreensChartFullInterval.zh: 周期可选 15分 / 1时 / 4时 / 1日 / 1周；左右拖动看更早的数据，双指缩放，长按看某一根的价格和时间。MA 与 VOL 由本机按图上的收盘价与成交量计算，没有单独的数据来源；除此之外没有其他指标，也没有画线工具。
